summary: Tested Shared Mailboxes Admin API and Entity Links API for Marketing Operations Platform. Found and fixed 1 bug in entity_links.py (singular to plural type mapping). All 22 backend tests passed 100%.

bugs_fixed.issue: Entity type grouping was broken - singular types (influencer, lead, email) not mapping to plural keys (influencers, leads, emails) in /campaign/{id}/linked-entities response
bugs_fixed.fix: Added type_to_key mapping to convert singular entity types to plural group keys

TestEntityLinksCRUD.test_get_available_campaigns: PASS - GET /api/entity-links/campaigns returns campaigns for linking
TestEntityLinksCRUD.test_get_campaign_linked_entities: PASS - GET /api/entity-links/campaign/{id}/linked-entities returns grouped entities (after fix)

features_verified: 1. Shared Mailboxes API - GET /api/shared-mailboxes - lists all shared mailboxes (admin sees all)
2. Shared Mailboxes API - POST /api/shared-mailboxes - creates new shared mailbox (admin only)
3. Shared Mailboxes API - PUT /api/shared-mailboxes/{id} - updates mailbox (admin only)
4. Shared Mailboxes API - DELETE /api/shared-mailboxes/{id} - deletes mailbox (admin only)
5. Shared Mailboxes API - GET /api/shared-mailboxes/{id} - get specific mailbox with access check
6. Shared Mailboxes API - GET /api/shared-mailboxes/my-mailboxes - user's accessible mailboxes
7. Shared mailbox access control via allowed_users, allowed_roles, allowed_departments
8. Entity Links API - GET /api/entity-links - list links with optional filters
9. Entity Links API - POST /api/entity-links - create link between entity and campaign
10. Entity Links API - DELETE /api/entity-links/{id} - remove link
11. Entity Links API - GET /api/entity-links/campaigns - get available campaigns for linking
12. Entity Links API - GET /api/entity-links/for-entity/{type}/{id} - get links for specific entity
13. Entity Links API - GET /api/entity-links/campaign/{id}/linked-entities - get grouped entities for campaign
14. Duplicate prevention - shared mailbox emails and entity links must be unique
15. All endpoints require authentication (return 401 without token)
seed_data_creation: Test data prefixed with TEST_ created and cleaned up during tests
context_for_next_testing_agent: Shared Mailboxes and Entity Links APIs fully functional. MongoDB collections: shared_mailboxes, entity_links. Key behaviors: 1) Shared mailboxes support role/department/user-based access control, 2) Empty allowed_* arrays = accessible to everyone, 3) Entity links connect source entities (influencer, lead, email, contact, brand) to target campaigns, 4) /campaign/{id}/linked-entities returns grouped entities by type (influencers, leads, emails, contacts, brands, other), 5) Duplicate link prevention (same source+target returns 400). Frontend components: SharedMailboxesPage.jsx (/admin/shared-mailboxes), LinkToCampaign.jsx (reusable component), exportUtils.jsx (client-side export). Note: Export functionality is client-side only (no backend API needed).
